' The employer will furnish to each worker on pay day an itemized accounting of earnings and of all legally-required and worker

deductions as required by law. All deductions will be made in accordance with FLSA regulations. Workers may repay any advances
and/or loans made to workers by pre-authorized payroll deductions. The employer does not envision any other uniform workforce-wide

the workers found to have been responsible for such damage to housing.
